create session NAME in the current directory and attach to it. Without -n
and -s, NAME is REPO-INDEX, REPO being the name of the git repository the
directory is in, or outside one of the directory itself, and INDEX 0 or, where
sessions REPO-INDEX run, one above the highest of their INDEX.

Usage:
  cld new [-n NAME | -s SUFFIX] [-w] [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help            help for new
  -n, --name NAME       session NAME: up to 64 letters, digits, "_" and "-",
                        starting with a letter or digit
  -s, --suffix SUFFIX   session REPO-SUFFIX, REPO being the name of the git
                        repository here, or outside one of the directory
  -w, --worktree        run claude in git worktree cld-NAME, which claude makes
                        from HEAD or reopens (claude --worktree cld-NAME)
